summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing a 6-for-1 reverse share split of its ordinary shares, expected to be implemented after market close on August 12, 2026, with post-split trading on Nasdaq beginning August 13, 2026. The reverse split, approved by shareholders on July 27, 2026, will reduce outstanding shares from 4,325,329 to 720,888. Authorized capital remains unchanged at 150,000,000 ordinary and 25,000 preferred shares; preferred conversion ratios adjust proportionally, and fractional shares round to nearest whole share. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation.
